description: This file provides utility methods for file operations such as reading from a file into engine state and saving a list of doubles to a file. It interacts with classes like EngineState and LinkManager to process input data and manage encoding.

classes.name: FileUtils
classes.description: Utility class offering static methods for reading files into engine state and saving list of doubles to files.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads a file line by line, packing each line and passing it to the engine state's processNewData method.

methods.name: readFile2
methods.description: Reads a file and processes each line by packing it and forwarding to engineState.

methods.name: saveList
methods.description: Saves a list of Double values to a file, each on a new line.
